summary: Kirmes Billing System - New Diagnostics Feature tested successfully. All features working: Backend diagnostics API returns last 10 raw measurements with all required fields (ts_utc, E_imp_kWh, P_sum_kW, U_L1/L2/L3, I_sum, F_Hz, cosphi), quick-info includes meter_id, frontend diagnostics panel opens on meter click with proper table columns and highlighting.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Diagnostics feature fully implemented and tested. Device Management page at /devices shows device list. Clicking on Kirmeskiste_001 expands row showing LETZTER KONTAKT and ZÄHLERSTÄNDE sections. Each meter entry shows 'Klick = Diagnose' hint. Clicking a meter opens diagnostics panel with table showing columns: ZEITSTEMPEL, KWH, KW, U L1, U L2, U L3, I GES., HZ, COS PHI. First row is highlighted with bg-fuchsia-50/30. Low voltage (<200V when >0) shown in red, bad frequency (<49 or >51 Hz) shown in amber. Close button (X) closes panel. Yellow highlight on Kirmes Event Detail page for unlinked meters still works (4 rows with bg-amber background).

tests_passed: Contains required fields (ts_utc, E_imp_kWh, P_sum_kW, U_L1/L2/L3, I_sum, F_Hz, cosphi)
